query: UPDATE api_keys SET disabled_at = $3, disabled_reason = CASE WHEN $3::timestamptz IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'manual' END, disabled_by_kind = CASE WHEN $3::timestamptz IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE $4 END, disabled_by_id = CASE WHEN $3::timestamptz IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE $5::uuid END, updated_at = now() WHERE project_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND archived_at IS NULL
